Hi all —

We have the executive workshop at Acme Financial (Seattle HQ, Jun 18). I'm starting the shipping plan for the demo units, swag, and printed one-pagers. Please review and confirm:

- Pickup window: earliest 6/16, target delivery 6/18 morning.
- Primary carrier: PackRight (cc'd) — please confirm transit SLA and insurance options.
- Packing list attached (packing_list_v2.xlsx): 3 crates (demo racks + monitors), 4 smaller boxes (swag + peripherals), and 2 envelope bundles with printed handouts.
- Swag manifest attached (swag_manifest.pdf): 150 shirts, 150 notebooks, 150 stickers.
- On-site contact: Helen Wu (helen.wu@acmefinancial.com) and Julian Alvarez office number listed in the sheet.

Action items:
1) PackRight: can you confirm pickup date availability and any dims/weight limits? Provide quote and tracking approach.
2) Connor: please confirm whether we need to palletize the racks or ship as crates + liftgate.
3) Marissa: final quantities for printed materials (how many one-pagers per attendee?).
4) Stephanie: travel plan for the onsite team (arrival/return) so we can label return-shipment pickup if needed.

Thanks — want to lock this by end of day Monday so procurement can approve the carrier.

— Ava

Hi Ava / team —

Thanks for the rundown. We have availability for pickup on Tue 6/16 and delivery to Seattle on Thu 6/18 (standard curb delivery) under our expedited business service. Preliminary notes:

- Quote attached (shipping_quote_PR-452.pdf). Includes basic transit insurance up to $10k, additional coverage available for an added fee.
- For the demo racks: recommended crate dims 48x40x36" each; weight ~220 lbs per crate. We can provide liftgate service at pickup and delivery for an extra $120 per stop.
- If you'd like a guaranteed morning delivery window (8–11a), that requires priority handling and an additional surcharge.
- We need final packaged dims/weights by Mon 6/15 5pm PT to confirm manifest and truckload.

Please reply with whether you want liftgate and morning delivery guarantee. We can add tracking that updates every checkpoint and provide POD (proof of delivery) scans.

Regards,
Sanjay Patel
Operations Manager, PackRight Logistics
ops@packright.com | +1 (206) 555-0224
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seattle workshop — shipping plan for demo units, swag & print materials

Thanks Sanjay — a few clarifications from our side:

- The crate weights are estimates; final build may be +10–15%. I recommend we add the higher insurance tier to be safe. Please price the additional coverage.
- For on-site handling: Acme has a receiving dock but internal movers will only be available after 1pm on Thu 6/18. If we request morning delivery we should also request inside-delivery or external mover on our side.
- Suggestion: split the shipment into two pickups: (a) crates + monitors (truck with liftgate, insured) on 6/16, and (b) swag + printed materials via commercial parcel ground on 6/16 same-day pickup. That reduces risk to the racks and simplifies PODs for swag.

On quoting, forwarding Sanjay's note for context:

> From: PackRight Logistics <ops@packright.com>
> Quote attached (shipping_quote_PR-452.pdf). Includes basic transit insurance up to $10k...

Ava / Marissa / Stephanie — can you confirm split-shipment approach? I'll proceed to raise the procurement PO once we have the final numbers.

— Conn

Thanks for coordinating. A couple quick notes from Acme Facilities:

- We can accept deliveries starting Thu 6/18. However the internal team is tied up with an executive prep meeting until ~1:00pm; could you plan to hold the printed one-pagers until after 1:00pm and deliver swag to the loading dock before noon?
- Loading dock address: Acme Financial — Seattle HQ, 2201 Elliott Ave, Dock B. On-site cell for day-of coordination: Julian Alvarez +1 (206) 555-0777.

All —

Thanks for the quick responses. We're locking the plan:

1) Split shipments (as Connor recommended):
   - Pickup A (6/16 morning): 3 crates (demo racks + monitors), palletized, liftgate required.
   - Pickup B (6/16 afternoon): 4 boxes with swag + 2 envelope bundles with printed materials via commercial parcel (separate tracking).
2) Insurance: upgrading to the $50k tier for the crates. PackRight, please add that to the invoice.
3) Delivery timing per Acme: swag to dock by 12:00pm Thu 6/18; printed materials to be held and delivered after 1:00pm. Please label accordingly.
4) On-site team travel: Stephanie and Connor will arrive evening 6/17 and depart 6/19 — they'll handle setup and return-shipment prep.

Attachments: final packing list and the pickup manifest (PackRight). Marissa — we settled on 150 printed one-pagers (one per attendee) and 10 extras.

Next steps: PackRight to confirm pickup times and provide provisional tracking numbers by EOD 6/15. I'll route the updated PO to procurement today.

— Ava
